title: Focused final check of repaired Market closure strings and Tshivenda changed candidates
scope: Read-only semantic check of the three final strings and scan of all 36 changed Tshivenda candidate strings for likely Xitsonga contamination. No learner-visible registry writes. No fluent approval.

worktree.headNote: Observed HEAD is the PR908 merge commit. A read-only diff from packet head 0778c666 to observed HEAD showed no changes in lib/course-modules.ts or the Sesotho, Tshivenda, and Xitsonga Market draft registry files, so the source/current content checked here remains stable across the merge.

finalStrings.sourceEnglish: Choose locally suitable crops and work backwards from the harvest you need. Check planting conditions and expected time to harvest.
finalStrings.candidate: Nangani crops dzine dza tea vhupo haṋu, ni pulane ni tshi vhalela murahu ni tshi bva kha harvest ine na i ṱoḓa. Ṱolani nyimele dza u zwala na tshifhinga tsho lavhelelwaho tsha u kaṋa.
finalStrings.reason: The revised clause makes planning explicit and counts backwards from the needed harvest. Planting conditions and expected harvest timing remain present. No modality or condition was added.

finalStrings.sourceEnglish: The example price is below the stated cost. Review the gap and customer demand before making the next production decision.
finalStrings.candidate: Nxavo wa xikombiso wu le hansi ka cost leyi boxiweke. Languta ku hambana ni customer demand u nga se endla xiboho xa production leyi landzelaka.
finalStrings.reason: “Xikombiso” clearly refers to an example. The below-cost relationship and the instruction to review the gap and demand before the next production decision remain intact.

finalStrings.sourceEnglish: Apply for a subsidy to cover the gap
finalStrings.candidate: Apply for subsidy u vala gap.
finalStrings.verdict: meaning preserved with explicit English anchor
finalStrings.reason: The English application phrase is retained as the requested anchor; the Tshivenda purpose clause conveys covering the gap. This does not introduce a guarantee or additional condition. It is not evidence of Xitsonga contamination.

tshivendaContaminationScan.result: No occurrences of those suspected forms were found in changed Tshivenda candidates. No other clear Xitsonga-form contamination was identified in this focused scan.
tshivendaContaminationScan.remainingEnglishNote: market-community-l2 body.paragraphs[5] still includes the English conditional clause “only when customers and growers can keep the agreement” and the phrase “when crops are short.” Their source conditions are preserved exactly; they are English residue, not identified as wrong-language forms.

reviewLimit: Semantic check only. Keep publication marked unreviewed and send for facilitator review afterward.
